Exercise: Elbow to Knee

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- rotational_flexion
- extension_of_the_spine

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- core_strength_and_stability
- spinal_flexibility

Contraindications:

- Individuals with lower back pain should perform this exercise with caution or seek guidance from a healthcare professional.

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- name: Russian Twists, equipment: body only

Instructions:

- Lie on the floor, crossing your right leg across your bent left knee. Clasp your hands behind your head, beginning with your shoulder blades on the ground. This will be your starting position.
- Perform the motion by flexing the spine and rotating your torso to bring the left elbow to the right knee.
- Return to the starting position and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
